info.description: Local JSON API of Bastion, served on 127.0.0.1 only. Records scans, detections, bench run summaries, triage state, filter documents and tag disputes. Nothing here changes detection logic: filter documents and disputes are records; the engine reads filters from the filters directory. Long scans and bench runs are jobs: queued, run one at a time, cancellable, and resumed after a restart.
